# alepe

Tidy access to the open data API of the Legislative Assembly of the
State of Pernambuco, Brazil
([ALEPE](https://dadosabertos.alepe.pe.gov.br)): representatives, staff,
positions, departments, remuneration, contracts, procurement, and
legislative propositions — as tibbles with clean names and parsed types.

- Built on [httr2](https://httr2.r-lib.org): local **caching**,
  automatic **retries with exponential backoff**, descriptive user
  agent.
- **Graceful failures**: network problems warn and return typed zero-row
  tibbles — your pipeline keeps running.
- Friendly progress messages via [cli](https://cli.r-lib.org),
  silenceable with `options(alepe.quiet = TRUE)`.

## Installation

``` r

# CRAN (once accepted)
install.packages("alepe")

# Development version
pak::pak("StrategicProjects/alepe")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(alepe)
library(dplyr)

# Current representatives
alepe_representatives()

# Permanent staff, largest departments
alepe_staff(status = "permanent") |>
  count(nome_lotacao, sort = TRUE)

# Contracts active today
alepe_contracts() |>
  filter(vigencia_inicio <= Sys.Date(), vigencia_fim >= Sys.Date())

# Bills of a given year
alepe_bills(year = 2024)
```

Filter values use an English vocabulary (`"permanent"`,
`"commissioned"`, `"seconded"`), but the original API terms
(`"efetivo"`, `"comissionado"`, `"a-disposicao"`) are accepted as well.
Column names keep the official Portuguese field names, normalized to
snake_case, so results stay traceable to the source.

## Related packages

Part of a family of packages for Brazilian public data sharing the same
httr2/cli design, developed at CASTLab/UFPE:
[transferegovr](https://github.com/StrategicProjects/transferegovr),
`tcepe`, `comex`, `ibger`.

# Package index

## Legislature

- [`alepe_representatives()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_representatives.md)
  : List current state representatives
- [`alepe_bills()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_bills.md)
  [`alepe_indications()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_bills.md)
  [`alepe_requests()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_bills.md)
  : Query legislative propositions

## Staff and payroll

- [`alepe_staff()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_staff.md)
  : List ALEPE staff
- [`alepe_positions()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_positions.md)
  : Count staff by position
- [`alepe_departments()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_departments.md)
  : Count staff by department
- [`alepe_remuneration()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_remuneration.md)
  : List remuneration by position

## Contracts and procurement

- [`alepe_contracts()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_contracts.md)
  : List administrative contracts
- [`alepe_procurements()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_procurements.md)
  : List procurement processes

## Utilities

- [`alepe_cache_dir()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_cache_dir.md)
  [`alepe_cache_clear()`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe_cache_dir.md)
  : Cache directory used by alepe
- [`alepe`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe-package.md)
  [`alepe-package`](https://strategicprojects.github.io/alepe/reference/alepe-package.md)
  : alepe: Access the Open Data API of the Legislative Assembly of
  Pernambuco
